response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) AS share FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
